indicators.name: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
indicators.pattern:
title: VSSAdmin Shadow Copy Deletion
id: 2b8a1c3d-9e0f-4b6a-8c1d-5e6f7a8b9c0d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://pharmaphorum.com/news/cyberattack-boston-scientific-causes-global-ops-disruption
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-30
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects attempts to delete volume shadow copies using vssadmin.exe, a behavior suggested as a hunting hint for attacks similar to the one against Boston Scientific.

indicators.name: Suspicious Wbadmin Execution

id: 8d9e0f1a-2b3c-4d5e-6f7a-8b9c0d1e2f3a
status: experimental
description: Detects suspicious use of the Windows Backup and Restore utility (wbadmin.exe), which could indicate an attempt to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://pharmaphorum.com/news/cyberattack-boston-scientific-causes-global-ops-disruption
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-30
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wbadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'delete'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of wbadmin.exe, particularly for deletion operations, a behavior suggested as a hunting hint for attacks similar to the one against Boston Scientific.

indicators.name: PsExec Service Installation
indicators.pattern:
title: PsExec Service Installation
id: 4a5b6c7d-8e9f-4a0b-1c2d-3e4f5a6b7c8d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of the PsExec service (PSEXESVC), which indicates the use of PsExec for lateral movement or remote execution.
references:
  - https://pharmaphorum.com/news/cyberattack-boston-scientific-causes-global-ops-disruption
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-30
tags:
  - attack.t1570
  - attack.execution
  - attack.lateral_movement
level: high
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: system
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 7045
    ServiceName: 'PSEXESVC'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the installation of the PsExec service, a behavior suggested as a hunting hint for lateral movement in attacks similar to the one against Boston Scientific.
